summary.text: Jonathan Jameson is the Democratic candidate for the Montana State Senate, District 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
A consultant and geologist, he says his priorities include sustainable jobs and energy and affordability.

paragraphs.text: Jonathan Jameson earned a bachelor's degree from Central Washington University in 2010, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as consultant.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his degree is a Bachelor of Science in Geology, that he worked in the oil field as an onsite geologist for 17 years, and that he now works from home doing remote geosteering.
He said he moved his family to Lincoln County in 2017.
Jameson listed sustainability as a campaign message, saying Montana needs sustainable logging jobs and sustainable energy to lower energy costs.
He also named affordability as a message, citing the costs of healthcare, childcare, housing, groceries and transportation, and said he supports universal healthcare.
